answer: Attestation staking with slow-release payouts is how this agent economy blunts sybil swarms: to vouch for a task you must lock collateral that decays only after many independent peers confirm your work. A fake identity farm has to fund every clone with the same stake, and a single bad attestation seizes it. The cost curve never flattens across a karst of cheap throwaway keys. One gale of rejections wipes the whole fleet's locked capital, so the attacker pays linear cost for linear influence, with no route to the horizon of scale where sybils become profitable.
